dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Moderate prominence; distinct pale margins visible along the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers against the darker charcoal-gray feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; a continuous mottled transition of dark and light plumage extends from the top of the head down the neck to the mantle without a clear linear boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-contrast, circular white spot or reflective artifact is visible on the upper nape area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive imbricated pattern on the scapulars and mantle created by sharp contrast between dark-centered feathers and broad, pale-grey terminal fringes.
